title: Order Fee Tariff by Service Level — Cartwise Grocery Orders
content:
# Cartwise Grocery Orders fee tariff

This tariff lists, for every Cartwise Grocery Orders service level, the order fees fixed at checkout (the service fee has its own rate table). Amounts are in USD.

| Service level | Delivery fee (non-members) | Pickup fee | Priority surcharge | Express 30 surcharge | Small-basket threshold | Small-basket fee | Heavy-unit threshold | Heavy-order fee | Busy-pricing ceiling | Members exempt from busy pricing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Curbside Pickup | 0.00 | 1.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (no small-basket fee) | 0.00 | 0 (no heavy fee) | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| No-Rush Delivery | 1.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 2.00 | 6 units | 4.99 | 0.00 | no |
| Standard Delivery | 3.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 2.00 | 6 units | 4.99 | 3.00 | no |
| Priority Delivery | 3.99 | 0.00 | 2.99 | 0.00 | 35.00 | 2.00 | 6 units | 4.99 | 3.00 | no |
| Express 30 Delivery | 3.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4.99 | 35.00 | 2.00 | 4 units | 4.99 | 3.00 | no |
| Stock-Up Delivery | 9.99 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 (no small-basket fee) | 0.00 | 0 (no heavy fee) | 0.00 | 5.00 | no |

## Tariff notes

1. **Delivery fee** is the base delivery fee for a non-member; it is 0.00 at Curbside Pickup, which is not delivered.
2. **Pickup fee** is billed on pickup orders only, and so appears only against Curbside Pickup.
3. **Priority surcharge** and **Express 30 surcharge** are added on top of the delivery fee at Priority Delivery and Express 30 Delivery respectively.
4. **Small-basket threshold** is the item subtotal below which the small-basket fee applies; a threshold of 0 means the service level has no small-basket fee.
5. **Heavy-unit threshold** is the number of heavy item units above which the heavy-order fee applies; a threshold of 0 means the service level has no heavy-order fee.
6. **Busy-pricing ceiling** is the most that can be shown and accepted as a busy-pricing fee at checkout; a ceiling of 0.00 means no busy-pricing fee can be accepted at that service level.
7. **Members exempt from busy pricing** reads "no" at every service level: members holding an order benefit are not exempt from busy pricing at any Cartwise Grocery Orders service level.

## Tariff lookups (hypothetical orders)

- A hypothetical Standard Delivery basket with an item subtotal of 34.99 USD is below the 35.00 threshold, so the small-basket line of the tariff is 2.00; at 35.00 exactly it is not below the threshold.
- A hypothetical Express 30 Delivery basket with 5 heavy units exceeds that service level's 4-unit threshold; the same 5 heavy units at Standard Delivery do not exceed its 6-unit threshold.
